## Follow-up Comments
Add a test for a stored session with an empty refresh token.
`23-23`: **📐 Maintainability & Code Quality** | **🔵 Trivial** | **⚡ Quick win** **Add a test for a stored session with an empty refresh token.** The new async tests only store `old-refresh`. A stored session with `"refresh_token": ""` passes `Session` validation and reaches the expiry branch in `_recover_and_refresh`. That branch keeps the session. `get_session()` then raises `AuthSessionMissingError` instead of returning a session or `None`. Add a test that pins the intended result for this case, in both the async and sync test modules. [Open the source location](https://github.com/supabase/supabase-py/blob/67628e0e05125c3cc5de901df999ec834e4f456d/src/auth/tests/_async/test_initialize_from_storage_keeps_session.py#L23)

Establish the intended get_session() outcome from the existing contract, then update _recover_and_refresh or the test expectation as needed so the expiry branch does not leave get_session() raising an unintended AuthSessionMissingError. ```

**Clear the stored session when a refresh is rejected with `AuthApiError`.** With `auto_refresh_token=False`, the PR keeps an expired session whose refresh token the server revoked. Each later `get_session()` call posts that token again and raises `AuthApiError`. The session is never cleared, so reads never reach the signed-out state. Clear the stored session on a non-retryable refresh rejection, or document that callers must call `sign_out()`.

**Remove an expired stored session that has no refresh token.** An expired stored session with an empty `refresh_token` now stays in storage. `_recover_and_refresh` skips the removal when the refresh token is empty. Later `get_session()` calls then raise `AuthSessionMissingError` instead of returning `None`. Before this change, the session was removed. Remove the session in this case:
Suggested fix
```diff refresh_token = current_session.refresh_token + if not refresh_token: + self._remove_session() + return if self._auto_refresh_token and refresh_token: ```
Apply the same change in `_async/gotrue_client.py`, then regenerate the sync client.
